audience: owners of household-goods and electrical-appliance shops in Egypt (non-technical), scrolling Facebook/Instagram, who juggle invoices, instalments, stock and the cash drawer by hand or with a weak program
promise: Mizan (ميزان, the Al-Store program) keeps the whole shop in balance: barcode selling with every payment method, every appliance's place, serial and warranty, shop instalments and credit, clear numbers
cta: راسلني واحجز عرض البرنامج (the CTA on the owner's three posters; no contact details supplied, so none are shown)
direction: ميزان = the scale. The mark's two bars on a fulcrum become the story: the shop's loads tip the beam, the copper bar levels it (the logo), then the same copper bar is the scanner laser, the total, the paid button, the shelf, the instalment progress and the tallest sales bar, and returns into the logo. Worlds: night → cream tile → ivory → night shelves → copper → night numbers → ivory payoff. Alexandria (display) + Readex Pro (UI) — the product's own fonts; the app's own icon set; client palette navy #13213c / cream #f3e9d8 / copper #c8743c. Container morphs on springs, slams, a blind pull, a circle wipe, a rising level. Original 120 BPM electro-pop, one hook in every chapter.

assets.rights: Client's own Mizan mark geometry (Store/web/js/brand.js, docs/brand/*.svg; 48-unit grid) re-drawn exactly in code from its numbers; colours from Store/docs/DESIGN.md; owner's product, public repository
Client's own UI icon paths copied from Store/web/img/icons.svg (owner's product); appliance glyphs drawn for this film
Readex Pro, SIL OFL (assets/fonts/OFL-readexpro.txt), copied from the client's own bundle Store/web/fonts; Alexandria already vendored (OFL)

sound.note: Original score synthesised in film18/score.mjs with lib/audio.mjs and lib/sfx.mjs on the shared clock film18/timing.js; no samples, no licence needed

creative.problem: at the end of the day invoices, instalments, stock and the safe don't add up
creative.evidence: the owner's three Mizan posters (headlines, feature names, staged practice-shop numbers, CTA) and the product spec in Store/docs; no invented clients, results or prices beyond the posters' practice-shop figures, labelled as practice data
creative.motif: the copper bar of the logo
creative.light: night navy with copper glows for problem/stock/numbers; ivory paper for selling and the payoff; one copper world for instalments
creative.camera: locked frames with push-ins, impact shakes, a pull-back into the logo and a dive into it
creative.motion: one copper container on springs through every job, word slams/drops/flips/blur-resolves, squash on landings
creative.sound: F minor tension → A flat major drop on the logo; hook returns per chapter on a new voice
creative.pacing: one idea per bar (2 s); headlines held 1.7–3.8 s; 1.4 s final hold
creative.payoff: the whole Mizan logo, name, the posters' tagline and the posters' CTA
